name: Sophos Endpoint
description: Sophos Endpoint (built on Intercept X technology) is an AI-powered endpoint protection platform that combines deep-learning malware detection, ransomware rollback, and exploit mitigation in a single lightweight agent, with optional EDR and XDR tiers for threat hunting and cross-vector investigation.
best_for: Security teams wanting prevention-first endpoint protection with built-in ransomware rollback, purchased through a Sophos partner rather than a self-serve online checkout.
features: 60+ proprietary exploit mitigations enabled by default to block attack techniques rather than specific exploit variants
Deep learning models that identify known and never-seen-before malware before execution
CryptoGuard ransomware protection that monitors file contents for malicious encryption, blocks the offending process, and automatically rolls back affected files
Adaptive Attack Protection that automatically increases defenses across endpoints when an active, coordinated attack is detected
Optional Sophos EDR (threat hunting) and Sophos XDR (cross-vector investigation with AI-assisted tools) built on the same agent
Web Control, Application Control, Peripheral Control, and Data Loss Prevention for attack-surface reduction
Sophos Fusion telemetry integration enabling Synchronized Security across the wider Sophos product stack
pros: 60+ exploit mitigations plus CryptoGuard rollback enabled by default with minimal configuration
30-day free trial available directly from Sophos's site
cons: No public price list on Sophos's own site -- Sophos Endpoint is sold through authorized partners or the AWS Marketplace, with pricing available only by quote
EDR and XDR threat-hunting capabilities are separate, higher tiers built on top of the base Endpoint agent, not included by default

tiers.name: Sophos Endpoint (via partner or AWS Marketplace)
tiers.notes: No list price is published on Sophos's own site. Sophos's how-to-buy page states it offers "simple, per-user pricing with no hidden extras" but directs buyers to "request a free, no-obligation quote" from a Sophos sales representative or an authorized partner; also purchasable via AWS Marketplace.

alternatives.name: SentinelOne
alternatives.description: An endpoint, cloud, and identity security platform running behavioral and static AI detection models on a single on-device agent to prevent, detect, and autonomously respond to threats.
alternatives.best_for: Security teams wanting a published per-endpoint list price and 1-click rollback as an alternative to Sophos Endpoint.
strengths: On-device AI models that don't depend on a live cloud connection

alternatives.name: CrowdStrike
alternatives.description: CrowdStrike Falcon is an AI-native cybersecurity platform that unifies endpoint detection and response, cloud security, and identity protection.
alternatives.best_for: Security teams wanting published starting list pricing and a next-gen SIEM alongside core endpoint protection.
strengths: Identity protection across human, non-human, and AI identities

faq.question: Does Sophos publish list prices for Sophos Endpoint?
faq.answer: No. Sophos's own how-to-buy page states it offers "simple, per-user pricing with no hidden extras" but does not publish the actual per-user rate -- buyers must request a quote from Sophos sales or purchase through an authorized partner or the AWS Marketplace.
